description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data types within the Darija Open Dataset, version 2. The chart contains five slices representing different categories of data. The largest slice, colored light green, is labeled “Pending Translations” and comprises approximately 45,387 data points. The next largest slice, colored steel blue, is labeled “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” and contains 30,000 data points. A yellow slice labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” represents a smaller proportion of the data. An orange slice labeled “Moroccan Names” and a dark blue slice labeled “Extra + Augmented Data” complete the chart, with the latter appearing to be the smallest segment. A legend is provided to the left of the chart, associating each color with its corresponding data type. The chart includes numerical labels indicating the data point count for three of the slices, and the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their visual size.
